run_gmock_gen: run gmock_gen.py to generate Google Mock classes from a C++ header file
generate_mock_classes: generate Google Mock class implementations for all classes in a C++ header file
generate_mock_for_class: generate a Google Mock class for a specific named class in a C++ header
review_gmock_class_generator: review the gmock_class module that parses C++ AST and generates mock class code
test_gmock_class_generator: test the gmock_class generator module to verify it produces correct mock class output
